metadata.name: samrajya
metadata.description: Samrajya — on-chain kingdom conquest on MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups

instructions.name: abort_game
docs: Stops a broken war (authority): it ends with no winner and every member can `claim` their
current value back once it is committed to Solana.

instructions.name: allocate
docs: Commit `amount` lamports of your value to attack `target` (255 = defend).

instructions.name: battle_callback
docs: VRF callback: resolves every battle with the oracle's randomness.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Winners claim their share of the whole pot. Base layer, after `end_game` and
`undelegate_player` have committed the final state.

instructions.name: delegate_game
docs: Moves the Game to the ER: anyone once the war has started (the lobby stays on Solana),
the authority any time.

instructions.name: delegate_player
docs: Delegates a Player PDA to the ER. The player may always (mid-war `join` sends it in the
same tx); anyone may once the war has started, for an enlisted player with nothing
waiting to be withdrawn (that is how the whole lobby moves to the ER at the start).

instructions.name: end_game
docs: Commits the finished game back to Solana so winners can `claim`, with any Players passed
as remaining accounts (the rest go through `release_players`).

instructions.name: enlist
docs: Turns the pending deposit into shares of `faction`.

instructions.name: init_game
docs: Creates the game and its SOL vault, and points the registry at it. Anyone may open
the next war once the previous one has ended and been committed back to base
(`end_game`), so nobody can pull players away from a war in progress. The vault is
pre-funded with rent so payouts never leave it below the rent-exempt minimum.

instructions.name: join
docs: Deposits the ticket into the vault. It becomes one equal share when the player
`enlist`s (on the ER while the game is delegated). Fails while the Player is delegated.

instructions.name: leave
docs: Leave the war; 80% of your value becomes `pending_withdrawal`. On the ER, follow with
`undelegate_player` in the same tx, then `withdraw` on base.

instructions.name: move_unit
docs: Moves your warrior (validated step), changes its action / gear / role, or teleports it
(`at` changes: to a realm your kingdom holds, or the one it ordered you to attack).

instructions.name: release_players
docs: After the war: commits and undelegates the Players passed as remaining accounts back to
Solana (permissionless; send in batches, then `end_game`).

instructions.name: resolve_epoch
docs: Permissionless game clock (the bell). Remaining accounts: every enlisted member's Player
(checked complete), so the program can read the hand fight at each fort: no living defender
inside and an attacker at the gate takes it, otherwise it holds (§10.8). Only an attack on
the open plains still needs the VRF; then the battles resolve in `battle_callback`.

instructions.name: resolve_epoch_debug
docs: Test-only resolution without VRF. Rejected unless built with `--features debug`.

instructions.name: seize
docs: Walks into an abandoned fort (§10.11): your warrior steps to (x, z) inside realm `at`'s walls
with an order on it, and no member of its owner stands alive there. Remaining accounts:
every Player with shares (the owner's are checked complete). The realm falls at once.

instructions.name: start_game
docs: Closes the lobby. The authority may start any time; anyone else once the lobby
timer has run out and at least two kingdoms have members.

instructions.name: strike
docs: Swings / shoots from (x, z) facing (fx, fz). Remaining accounts: the Players the client
believes are in reach (writable); the program re-checks reach, arc, walls and blocking,
wounds them, and batters the gate when the blow hits nobody.

instructions.name: switch_kingdom
docs: Move to another kingdom; 40% of your value stays behind.

instructions.name: undelegate_player
docs: Commits the Player back to base (after `leave`, or after the game ends to `claim`).

instructions.name: upgrade
docs: Spend kingdom treasury on the next level of an upgrade (0 = walls, 1 = armory).

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Pays out `pending_withdrawal` (set by `leave`) from the vault. Base layer, after the
Player has been committed back with `undelegate_player`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone may trigger; funds only go to `player.wallet`.

fields.name: defender
docs: `NEUTRAL` when the plains were attacked before anyone held them.

fields.name: defense
docs: Size of the defender's bucket (defender wins if roll < defense).

fields.name: spoils
docs: Treasury moved to the winner (loot or failed-attack losses), after the plains tax.

fields.name: by_fight
docs: Decided by the hand fight (a walled realm): no roll; captured if the fort was cleared.

types.name: Faction
docs: One kingdom. Stored inline in `Game` so battles touch a single account.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Accounting lamports (real SOL sits in the vault). Also the kingdom's army strength.

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Player value = shares × treasury / total_shares. Each member holds `SHARES_PER_MEMBER`.

fields.name: generation
docs: Bumped when the kingdom is wiped out, so stale shares are worth 0.

fields.name: attack_alloc
docs: Lamports of value committed this epoch to attack each territory.

fields.name: upgrades
docs: Level of each upgrade (`UPGRADE_WALLS`, `UPGRADE_ARMORY`).

fields.name: upgraded_epoch
docs: Epoch of the last upgrade purchase (one per kingdom per epoch).

fields.name: epoch_ends_at
docs: End of the current epoch, or of the lobby while `phase == Lobby`.

fields.name: base_defense
docs: Current flat defense (decays every epoch).

fields.name: plains_defense
docs: Current garrison of the neutral plains (decays every epoch).

fields.name: plains_pot
docs: Lamports waiting for the plains holder: the plains tax, upgrade spending and attacks
lost against the neutral garrison. Paid to the holder at the end of every epoch.

fields.name: territory_owner
docs: Faction index owning each territory (`NEUTRAL` for an unheld plains).

fields.name: winner
docs: Valid only when phase == Ended.

fields.name: battle_count
docs: Total number of battles ever logged; next slot = battle_count % BATTLE_LOG_LEN.

fields.name: gates
docs: Gate hit points per homeland (repaired at every bell).

fields.name: fight
docs: The hand fight's verdict per territory for the bell being resolved (`fight_set`):
the owner = held, another faction = it cleared the fort.

fields.name: ticket
docs: Everyone enters with exactly this many lamports, and every member owns an equal share.

fields.name: base_defense
docs: Starting flat defense every territory gets; decays each epoch ("the storm").

fields.name: plains_defense
docs: Garrison of the neutral plains; decays with the storm like `base_defense`.

fields.name: plains_tax_bps
docs: Cut of every battle's spoils that goes to the plains pot.

fields.name: upgrade_cost_bps
docs: Upgrade level `n` (1-based) costs `n × upgrade_cost_bps` of the treasury.

fields.name: upgrade_bonus_bps
docs: Each upgrade level adds this much to attack (armory) or defense (walls).

fields.name: conquest_bonus_bps
docs: Attack and defense bonus per territory held beyond the first.

fields.name: lobby_secs
docs: After this long in the lobby anyone may start the war.

fields.name: pending_deposit
docs: SOL deposited on base but not yet turned into shares (`enlist` on the ER).

fields.name: pending_withdrawal
docs: SOL owed after `leave`, paid by `withdraw` on base.

fields.name: deposited_total
docs: Lifetime SOL put in, for P&L in the UI.

types.name: Registry
docs: Points the app at the newest war. Lives on base and is never delegated.

types.name: Unit
docs: A member's warrior on the battlefield (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §10, `field.rs`). Positions are in
the realm's coordinates ×100 (keep at the origin, the gate mid-edge at +z).

fields.name: at
docs: Territory the warrior stands in (`NO_REALM` when it has none).

fields.name: fx
docs: Facing as a unit vector ×100.

fields.name: strikes
docs: Counts strikes (wrapping) so every client can animate each blow.

fields.name: dead_until
docs: Fallen: back on its feet at home at this time. 0 = alive.

fields.name: strike_sec
docs: Strike rate limit: strikes made during `strike_sec`.

fields.name: dodge_at
docs: Last roll (`ACTION_DODGE`): untouchable for about a second, once per `DODGE_COOLDOWN_SECS`.
